title: On Performing the whole piece without a score
subtitle: 戏剧表演 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：perform　|　正文 367 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 perform 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the porter ① performed the whole piece without a score for the whole place, and every visitor in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the porter ② performs the whole piece without a score without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ perform the whole piece without a score at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ performed the whole piece without a score before — a line in the journal for August 1973 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Performing the whole piece without a score for the whole place, the porter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ perform the old rite every spring without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Perform the old rite every spring at once and never mention it again.

By 1986 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new visitor from the next coast ⑧ performs the old rite every spring for the whole place every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cove, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ performed the whole piece without a score again when nobody else would.

⑩ To perform the whole piece without a score, my mother said in 1991, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the coast remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the coast forgets, somebody performs the whole piece without a score without a word of thanks again and somebody must perform the whole piece without a score for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 演奏（一般过去式 performed the whole piece without a score：1979 年挑夫头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 演奏（一般现在 performs the whole piece without a score：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 演奏（不定式 to perform the whole piece without a score：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 演奏（过去完成时 had performed the whole piece without a score：1973 年八月的行记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 演奏（动名词 performing the whole piece without a score 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 履行（perform the old rite every spring：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去履行年年春天履行那套旧礼仪）
G. v. 履行（perform the old rite every spring：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 演奏（后段两处：新来的游客照例 performs the old rite every spring，而母亲又一次 performed the whole piece without a score）

answers.why: perform 意为“演奏”，1979 年挑夫替所有人演奏不看谱演完整部曲子，那是海岸里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 performed。
perform 意为“演奏”，自那以后挑夫不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 performs。
perform 意为“演奏”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯演奏不看谱演完整部曲子”，此处为不定式 to perform the whole piece without a score。
perform 意为“演奏”，行记里 八月 那行字说明早在 1986 年之前就有人演奏过，故用过去完成时 had performed。
perform 意为“演奏”，挑夫说“演奏不看谱演完整部曲子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 performing the whole piece without a score 作主语。
perform 意为“履行”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去履行年年春天履行那套旧礼仪”，should ever 之后用原形 perform the old rite every spring。
perform 意为“履行”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻履行年年春天履行那套旧礼仪（perform the old rite every spring at once），以后再也不要提起。
perform 意为“演奏”，新来的游客每个星期都照例履行年年春天履行那套旧礼仪，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 performs。
perform 意为“演奏”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人演奏不看谱演完整部曲子，用一般过去式 performed 叙述。
perform 意为“演奏”，结尾那句是母亲 1991 年的话：要演奏不看谱演完整部曲子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和海岸记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，挑夫替所有人演奏不看谱演完整部曲子；海岸里每一个游客都说这是头一回。（performed the whole piece without a score）
多年以后，挑夫仍不图一句谢做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（performs the whole piece without a score）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯演奏不看谱演完整部曲子这件事本身。（to perform the whole piece without a score）
早在 1973 年就有人演奏不看谱演完整部曲子，八月那天行记上的一行字就是证据。（had performed the whole piece without a score）
挑夫说过，替所有人演奏不看谱演完整部曲子这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（performing the whole piece without a score 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻履行年年春天履行那套旧礼仪，以后再也不要提起。（perform the old rite every spring，祈使句）

Three weeks on, the porter still performs the whole piece without a score without a word of thanks without being asked.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 perform 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the porter performed the whole piece without a score for the whole place, and nobody in the coast forgot it.
Even now the porter performs the whole piece without a score without a word of thanks whenever the coast asks.
Performing the whole piece without a score for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever perform the old rite every spring without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next coast performs the old rite every spring for the whole place every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother performed the whole piece without a score again, and the coast remembered that half.
